topic: Sampling Flavors at an Ice-Cream Shop

script.title: SAMPLING ICE CREAM
script.story_hook: Choosing ice cream takes the whole afternoon.
script.intro_zh: 選冰淇淋，常常一選就是一個下午。
script.welcome_en: Hello friends! Today we're sampling ice cream flavors.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們！今天來冰淇淋店試吃、挑口味。
script.outro: Sweet choices, easy English. Go on, treat yourself!
script.outro_zh: 甜美選擇、輕鬆英文。去犒賞自己一下吧！
script.practice_intro_en: Ready to repeat? Let's hear your voice.
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好跟讀了嗎？讓我在這裡聽見你。

script.youtube_description:

Frozen in front of the freezer case? This 18-line ice-cream shop scene covers asking for samples, learning the shop rules, choosing between cone and cup, and settling in with your kid. Natural American English with IPA transcription plus a repeat-after-me section to make the phrases yours.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍦冰店英文｜要試吃勺・問口味規則・甜筒或杯｜聽完就會點冰｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
櫃檯前排著幾十種口味，一句都說不出口？
帶著小朋友，甜筒和杯子又該怎麼選？

這一集帶大家走進一個陽光下午的冰淇淋店，跟著奶奶和店員從要試吃、問規則，到選杯子、加淋醬、找座位，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🥄 要試吃：例如「can we sample a few flavors?」、「two tiny spoons for you.」
🍦 做決定：例如「Cone or cup?」、「Two cups then, one for each of us.」
💳 結賬與座位：例如「That'll be nine fifty.」、「Where can my kid sit down?」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下一個甜甜下午，就用英文開心開口吧！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a tiny tasting spoon over a caramel scoop

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! Can we sample a few flavors before choosing?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ kæn wi ˈsæmpəl ə ˈfjuː ˈfleɪvərz bɪˈfɔr ˈtʃuzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！可以先試吃幾個口味再決定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Three samples per person, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs θri ˈsæmpəlz pər ˈpɜrsən ðæts ðə rul/
dialogue.zh: 當然！規則是每人可以試吃三勺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my helper here can't decide at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt maɪ ˈhɛlpər hɪr kænt dɪˈsaɪd ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我身邊這位小幫手完全選不下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look serious! Which ones are we trying?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ lʊk ˈsɪriəz wɪtʃ wʌnz ər wi ˈtraɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 看起來好認真！想先試哪幾種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salted caramel first, then the cookies and cream.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔltɪd ˈkɑrəməl fɜrst ðɛn ðə ˈkʊkɪz ænd krim/
dialogue.zh: 先試鹹焦糖，然後是曲奇奶油口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming right up, two tiny spoons for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ raɪt ʌp tu ˈtaɪi spunz fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 馬上來，給您兩支小試吃勺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one sample of pistachio, for the grown-up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn ˈsæmpəl ʌv pɪsˈtæʃioʊ fɔr ðə ˈɡroʊn ˈʌp/
dialogue.zh: 再來一勺開心果，是給我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. So how are you eating this today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt soʊ haʊ ər ju ˈitɪŋ ðɪs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 了解。那今天想怎麼吃呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cone or cup? That's the big question, um...
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊn ɔr kʌp ðæts ðə bɪɡ ˈkwɛstʃən ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 甜筒還是杯子？這是個大問題，呃……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cone crunchies melt fast with a little kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊn ˈkrʌnʧiz mɛlt fæst wɪð ə ˈlɪtəl kɪd/
dialogue.zh: 帶小孩子的話，甜筒的脆餅化得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True! Two cups then, one for each of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru tu kʌps ðɛn wʌn fɔr itʃ ʌv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 說得對！那就兩杯，一人一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Want the chocolate dip on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt wɑnt ðə ˈtʃɑklət dɪp ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。上面要加巧克力淋醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh my, yes. The caramel one, not the kids'.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ jɛz ðə ˈkɑrəməl wʌn nɑt ðə kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 噢當然要！焦糖那款，小朋友那份就不用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a pro. That'll be nine fifty total.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ə proʊ ðætəl bi naɪn ˈfɪfti ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 您是常客了。總共九塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth every cent. Where can my kid sit down?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ˈɛvri sɛnt wɛr kæn maɪ kɪd sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 每一分都值得。我家寶貝可以坐哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two stools at the window, right this way.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stulz æt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ raɪt ðɪs weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 窗邊有兩張高腳凳，這邊請。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made our afternoon, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ˈaʊər ˈæftərˌnun θæŋk ju su mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你讓我們一下午都好開心，太謝謝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet! Enjoy the samples... I mean the scoops.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈsæmpəlz aɪ min ðə skups/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢享用你們的試吃……我是說冰淇淋球！
